title: Fix typo in ShopServer error message
description: Replaces 'inssufficient' with 'insufficient' in the ShopServer 'not enough coins' branch.

ops.source:
-- ShopServer.luau
local Remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes")
local BuyItem = Remotes:WaitForChild("BuyItem")

BuyItem.OnServerInvoke = function(player, itemId)
    local data = require(script.Parent.PlayerData):Get(player)
    if data.coins < 100 then
        return false, "insufficient coins"
    end
    data.coins -= 100
    return true
end
